woocommerce.desired: پرداخت آنلاین با درگاه سان پی
woocommerce.operation: Update the native WooCommerce gateway display title through the WordPress Options API. The title is shared by WooCommerce views that use the current gateway title.
woocommerce.preserve: Gateway ID, provider, enabled state, all other gateway fields, and existing orders.
woocommerce.precondition: Require an exact match of the previously read settings before updating the title. Verify the remaining settings against the prior state on readback.
woocommerce.acceptance: The saved option and WooCommerce checkout label render the exact desired title.
woocommerce.rollback: Restore the previous title only if the current title still matches the desired title. Preserve any intervening changes to other fields.
